programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat – or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what’s really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn’t so simple, the danger is very real.

programme.title: Encounter
programme.desc: A group of friends uncover an otherworldly object in a rural field, which they soon discover holds greater secrets than they could imagine.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Lyon Gaultier, a member of the French Foreign Legion who deserts his post in order to come to America and help the family of his murdered brother. But crossing the U.S. without a penny to his name proves difficult. Lyon then takes up the sport of bare-knuckle fighting, earning him the money to reach his destination and support his loved ones -- but with the Foreign Legion hot on his trail, will he ever find peace?

programme.title: Marrowbone
programme.desc: A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.

programme.title: Night Moves
programme.desc: Three radical environmentalists look to execute the protest of their lives: the explosion of a hydroelectric dam.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

programme.title: Police Story: Lockdown
programme.desc: The highly-anticipated fifth installment of the Police Story franchise, starring Jackie Chan in a story of family ties, betrayal, and revenge.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: Uncaged
programme.desc: After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.

programme.title: SPLINTER
programme.desc: Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Monsters in the Closet
programme.desc: A horror's author's stories come to life when read out loud.

programme.title: Mermaid Down
programme.desc: A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

programme.title: Impossible Monsters
programme.desc: Dr. Rich Freeman (Tony Award winner Santino Fontana), an ambitious and well-liked psychology professor, pursues a sleep study with a focus on nightmares, dreams, and sleep paralysis -- the success of which would result in a lucrative grant. As the line between dreams and reality blur, a member of the study is murdered, and everything begins to unravel, leaving Rich fighting to make things right.

programme.title: Bigfoot Country
programme.desc: Some say Bigfoot is just a hoax, but when a group of hikers go deep into the woods after being warned by a guide that has encountered a Sasquatch, they begin to realize that they are not alone...

programme.title: Lake Alice
programme.desc: The Thomases visit their family cabin to celebrate Christmas with their daughter and her boyfriend, but their first holiday together may be their last.

programme.title: Book of Monsters
programme.desc: Sophie's 18th birthday becomes a bloodbath when monsters descend upon her house and start to devour the party guests.

programme.title: The Cursed
programme.desc: A supernatural thriller set in a cozy Tennessee town where Sheriff Jimmy Muldoon and younger brother, Deputy Lloyd Muldoon, have a firm grasp of law and order until a stranger, Denny White, comes to town and horrible things begin to happen.

programme.title: The Mimic
programme.desc: A classic Korean ghost story gets a horrifying new spin. As the mother of a missing child takes in a lost girl she finds in the woods, she soon begins to wonder if she is even human.

programme.title: Wraith
programme.desc: After living in an old mansion for almost 10 years a family suddenly discovers a ghost-like presence trying to communicate with them.

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!
programme.desc: The unlikely heroic duo of a blue-collar exterminator and Latino security guard must save the day when a military major loses control of a giant spider rampaging through the city of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Ghostly Tribe
programme.desc: A soldier is working in a snowcapped mountain when an explosion reveals bizarre fossils hidden deep in the caverns. What they discover next will change human history forever.

programme.title: St. Agatha
programme.desc: A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: The Lingering
programme.desc: When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.title: The Love Witch
programme.desc: A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.

programme.title: The Sacrament
programme.desc: A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.

programme.title: The Truth About Emanuel
programme.desc: A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.desc: The Rückert-Lieder are a collection of five art songs by Mahler, set to poems by Friedrich Rückert, showcasing his gift for intimate and deeply personal musical expression in a style that balances simplicity with profound emotional complexity.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programme.title: La Bayadere
programme.desc: The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

programme.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, "Little Russian."

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programme.title: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programme.title: Calles en Guerra
programme.desc: Lucas (Elijah Rodriguez) es un adolescente de 14 años al que la vida de pandillero ha seducido en la ciudad de Washington D.C. Pese a ello, tiene claro que hará todo lo posible por evitar que su hermano de 10 años siga sus mismos pasos. Cuando un veterano de la guerra de Afganistán (Jean-Claude Van Damme) llega a su barrio, Lucas encuentra una oportunidad única para que éste se convierta en el tutor de su joven hermano.

programme.title: Herencia Maldita
programme.desc: Después de quedar ciega en un trágico accidente de coche, Rebecca recibe una extraña noticia: su madre, desaparecida hace mucho tiempo, falleció recientemente, dejándola en el castillo ancestral de su familia en la Albania rural. Al viajar a la propiedad con un grupo de amigos, Rebecca espera que sea una oportunidad para que ella se reconecte con un pasado que nunca conoció. Cuando comienzan a ocurrir eventos misteriosos y sus amigos comienzan a morir, Rebecca debe descubrir los secretos de la historia de su familia antes de que ella también sea víctima del Castle Freak.

programme.title: Furia
programme.desc: La tranquila Rose trabaja en ropa de moda femenina, con la esperanza de ser diseñadora. Un accidente de tráfico le daña la cara. Recibe un tratamiento experimental con células madre, que la deja más fuerte y más bonita que nunca, pero tiene un efecto secundario.

programme.title: Conexión Mortal
programme.desc: La película es una escalofriante historia del viaje de un padre para encontrar a su esposa e hijo. Clay Riddell se encuentra en Boston y de repente el infierno se desata ante sus ojos. Sin previo aviso, reina la matanza y el caos. La gente común es víctima de los más viles actos, la destrucción más animal. Y el apocalipsis comienza con el llamado de un teléfono celular.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario de vacaciones en un crucero se enfrenta a más de lo que puede manejar cuando lo descubren muerto en la cubierta. ¿Fue un trágico accidente o alguien tenía una cuenta pendiente con este negociador?

programme.title: Shark Week
programme.desc: Un grupo de desconocidos se encuentran aislados por un millonario loco en su compuesto de isla. Son obligados a participar en un terrorífico calvario donde deben sobrevivir a una andanada de especies de tiburones cada vez más mortíferas.

programme.title: La Maldición
programme.desc: Inspirado en el folclore de Europa del Este, una traición impensable lleva a que se coloque una maldición maléfica sobre el linaje de una familia. Décadas más tarde, una boda une a la próxima generación de familias separadas. Cuando uno de ellos, sin saberlo, despierta una fuerza oscura que comienza a eliminarlos uno por uno, Hana, la matriarca del linaje actual, debe descubrir quién está trabajando contra ellos antes de que la maldición sangrienta se apodere de ellos para siempre.

programme.title: Terror en el Aire
programme.desc: Cuando el parabrisas de su avión comercial se rompe a 30,000 pies en el aire, un piloto y su tripulación de vuelo trabajan para garantizar la seguridad de los pasajeros y aterrizar el avión.

programme.title: Jogo Macabro

programme.title: Baba Yaga: El regreso del demonio
programme.desc: Egor llega a casa y descubre que su hermana pequeña ha desaparecido junto con la niñera. Sus padres se encuentran en un extraño estado de trance y no recuerdan tener una hija. Egor se pone en marcha con sus amigos para buscarla. Están convencidos de que la niñera es un antiguo demonio eslavo que antes se llamaba Yaga. Y si los niños no tienen éxito en su búsqueda, sus padres también los olvidarán.

programme.title: Asesinos a Sueldo
programme.desc: Inspirada en la historia real de un escándalo en el que reclusos son liberados por un día para trabajar como sicarios de políticos corruptos. Las historias de cuatro hombres que intentan mantener a sus familias se conectan a través de la prisión: dos reclusos que son contratados como asesinos y dos policías que investigan los asesinatos. Mientras se enfrentan, son sus seres queridos los que corren el riesgo de sufrir daños colaterales.

Juntos se enfrentarán a todos los obstáculos hasta encontrar a los responsables, sin importarles que sus vidas sean el precio que tengan que pagar en su búsqueda de venganza

programme.title: Masacre en el Barrio Chino
programme.desc: Nick Jackie Chan es un inmigrante chino, que ha entrado ilegalmente en Japón en busca de su novia y de un futuro mejor. Al principio, malvive explotado junto a otros compatriotas con los que arriesga su vida y su libertad a cambio de un mísero salario. Al descubrir, por azar, que su novia es ahora la esposa de un jefe Yakuza, decide entrar en el mundo del crimen organizado convirtiéndose en poco tiempo, con la ayuda del jefe Yakuza a quién casualmente salva la vida, en un auténtico líder, aprendiendo como sobrevivir en un mundo donde la corrupción, el asesinato y las luchas internas entre las distintas mafias, ponen constantemente a prueba su liderazgo y sus principios.

programme.title: Libertador
programme.desc: Simón Bolívar libró más de 100 batallas contra el Imperio español en Sudamérica. Recorrió más de 112.000 kilómetros a caballo. Sus campañas militares abarcaron el doble del territorio de Alejandro Magno. Su ejército nunca conquistó, sino que liberó.

programme.title: La Hermana Buena
programme.desc: Fontayne es reclutada por Bernice (su vieja amiga distanciada y actual oficial de libertad condicional) junto con un policía deshonrado para buscar al hijo de Bernice, que desapareció en la frontera con México.

programme.title: Nick Tschiller - Bienvenidos a Hamburgo
programme.desc: En su primer caso, Tschiller descubre un refugio de prostitución menor – hasta que los proxenetas llegan.

programme.title: Punto De Ruptura
programme.desc: Drama judicial que ejemplifica la historia de la lucha entre David y Goliath. Un abogado adicto a las drogas que se enfrasca en una lucha legal contra una gran corporación de suministros farmacéuticos. Mientras además tiene que hacer frente a sus demonios personales

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: La trama gira en torno al contratista militar británico Lex Walker, a quien le informan que su hija ha muerto. Al llegar a Los Ángeles y descubrir que el cuerpo no es el suyo, inicia una investigación.

programme.desc: Tras una pelea en un bar, un padre borracho mata a su hijo accidentalmente. Šima es condenado por asesinato y enviado a prisión

programme.title: Retornados
programme.desc: La humanidad convive con los "Retornados", personas de aspecto normal que han sido infectadas por un virus devastador. Sólo la inyección diaria de una proteína impide que se conviertan en zombis. Kate trabaja en una unidad de investigación que intenta encontrar urgentemente una vacuna definitiva para detener la propagación de la epidemia. También oculta una poderosa razón: su compañero, Alex, es un "devuelto".

programme.title: La ley del sheriff Breaker
programme.desc: Una orden de arresto lleva al alguacil John Breaker y al ayudante Bugle a cruzar el país para entregar a un peligroso criminal. Pero, cuando defienden a un juez, ¿podrán defender a un pequeño pueblo de la banda más despiadada del Oeste?

programme.title: October Gale
programme.desc: Una doctora invita en su casa a un hombre misterioso en su remota cabaña con una herida de bala.

programme.title: Black Rose
programme.desc: El Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles contrata a un comandante de la policía rusa para ayudar a resolver una serie de horribles asesinatos perpetrados contra mujeres jóvenes por un sádico asesino sociópata en las calles de Hollywood.

programme.title: Dirty Lies
programme.desc: La desaparición de un collar de un millón de dólares pone patas arriba la vida de un joven asistente. Debe averiguar en tiempo récord quién de sus compañeros le ha traicionado. Además, su vida corre peligro porque unos criminales persiguen también la codiciada joya. Y el tiempo se acaba.

programme.title: Inquebrantable
programme.desc: La historia del atleta olímpico Eric Liddell, quien fue prisionero de guerra en China durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.desc: En 1931, un abogado defensor de Nueva York (Timothy Hutton) acude en ayuda de nueve hombres negros acusados ​​de violar a dos mujeres blancas en el sur.

programme.title: Ríos de Sangre
programme.desc: Cuando el hijo de un juez afroamericano es asesinado en una parada de rutina que sale mal, el juez Charles Coleman toma la justicia en sus propias manos para asegurarse de que se haga justicia cuando los dos policías salgan libres.

programme.desc: Un ex neonazi busca redención y una nueva vida después de dejar atrás su pasado violento y racista.

programme.title: Ted Bundy. En la mente del asesino
programme.desc: En los años 70-80, el FBI desarrolla métodos para perfilar asesinos en serie. Basada en hechos reales, la historia sigue la relación entre el agente Bill Hagmeier y Ted Bundy durante sus últimos años en el corredor de la muerte. Durante más de cinco años, el agente intenta comprender la mente del asesino, que negó sus crímenes pese a haber causado decenas de muertes.

programme.title: Balas y Katanas
programme.desc: Balas y Katanas es una película loca, descarada y…diferente. Una divertida experiencia inmersiva para el espectador, con una primera parte de 50 minutos, rodada en plano secuencia, en la cual el espectador acompaña a los protagonistas en su aventura y sus peleas. A la que le seguirá una segunda parte de otros 40 minutos, rodada al más puro estilo del cine clásico de Hong Kong de los ’80. Una loca aventura llena de guiños al género, "cameos" y homenajes, donde los protagonistas incluso se llegarán a reír hasta de sí mismos.

programme.title: Confesión final
programme.desc: El Padre Peter trabaja solo en la iglesia cuando aparece Victor, un hombre armado y gravemente herido. Bajo amenaza, se ve obligado a escuchar sus confesiones, marcadas por el deseo de venganza. A medida que avanza la conversación, Peter descubre que ambos comparten un pasado oscuro que creía haber dejado atrás.

programme.desc: Después de un atraco fallido, se ordena a una violenta banda de delincuentes que localicen y eliminen al hombre que los traicionó y huyó con su botín.

programme.title: Lies We Tell
programme.desc: Un conductor de confianza debe lidiar con la amante musulmana de su jefe muerto, cuyo oscuro pasado lo arrastra a un enfrentamiento de vida o muerte con su notorio primo / ex esposo gángster.

programme.title: Escape Room 2: Mueres por salir
programme.desc: Escape Room 2: Mueres por salir es la secuela del exitoso thriller psicológico que aterrorizó a espectadores alrededor del mundo. En esta entrega, seis personas se encuentran encerradas de manera inesperada en una nueva serie de escape rooms, revelando paulatinamente aquello que tienen en común para sobrevivir… y descubriendo que todos ya habían jugado el juego con anterioridad.

programme.title: Underworld: El Despertar
programme.desc: Cuando las fuerzas humanas descubren la existencia de los clanes Vampiro y Lycan, una guerra para erradicar ambas especies comienza. La vampira guerrera Selene lidera la batalla contra la humanidad.

programme.title: Driven
programme.desc: Un joven piloto exitoso está en medio de una temporada de campeonato y se está desmoronando. Llaman a un ex campeón de CART para que lo guíe.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Una nave espacial que viaja a un planeta-colonia lejano y transporta a miles de personas, tiene una avería en una de sus cámaras de sueño. Como resultado, un único pasajero se despierta 90 años antes de tiempo. Ante la perspectiva de envejecer y morir solo, finalmente decide despertar a un segundo pasajero.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: ¡Vuelven Los Cazafantasmas! Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis y Sigourney Weaver. Son los auténticos cazadores de seres sobrenaturales, los únicos que pueden salvar al mundo de la fantasmagórica plaga que se extiende por todo el planeta. Ya han llegado a New York. La estatua de la libertad está en peligro.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.

programme.title: Black Hawk Derribado
programme.desc: Las tropas americanas llegaron a Somalia con la esperanza de salvar vidas y no de arrebatarlas. Los soldados, atrapados en la política feudal de Somalia, en la que un clan lleva un milenio enfrentado a otro, se verán condenados a una brutal experiencia cuando la misión da un giro insospechado… resultando en la más grande y singular batalla militar americana desde Vietnam.

programme.title: The Raid 2: Berandal
programme.desc: Poco después de finalizar la sangrienta redada, el inspector Rama se ve obligado a infiltrarse en las filas del sindicato del crimen de Yakarta con el fin de proteger a su familia y descubrir la corrupción en el seno de su propia fuerza policial.

programme.title: S.W.A.T: Operación Especial
programme.desc: Transferido a Detroit para entrenar a un equipo SWAT local a través de un duro régimen, el teniente Paul Cutler (policía de Los Ángeles) se termina metiendo entre los planes de un genio homicida que está protegido por funcionarios del gobierno.

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt (Gabriel Macht) es un detective enmascarado, un héroe sin superpoderes que protege del crimen a los habitantes de Central City. Colt persigue sin tregua al villano Octopus (Samuel L. Jackson), que asesina sin piedad a cualquiera que le vea la cara. Adaptación de la novela gráfica de Will Eisner.

programme.title: Gloria (1999)
programme.desc: Gloria ha pasado tres años en la cárcel por culpa de su novio mafioso, Kevin. Nada más salir, se salta la libertad condicional y vuelve a Nueva York con su banda. Al llegar, se encuentra con que Kevin y los suyos han secuestrado a un niño después de matar a sus padres.

programme.title: Cazafantasmas (2016)
programme.desc: Nueva versión de una de las películas más emblemáticas de los años ochenta: Los cazafantasmas. Después de casi treinta años, los fantasmas y demonios se han vuelto a escapar de los infiernos para destruir Manhattan. Ahora, el equipo de los Cazafantasmas está formado por un grupo de mujeres dispuestas a terminar con todas las amenazas paranormales.

programme.title: Abismo
programme.desc: Gail Berke y David Sanders están pasando unas idílicas vacaciones en las Bermudas. Mientras practican submarinismo, de repente, se topan con los restos del naufragio de un buque de carga de la segunda Guerra Mundial, en cuyo interior hallan miles de ampollas de morfina. Este descubrimiento los lleva a ponerse en contacto con un traficante haitiano y un buscador de tesoros

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Un monstruo gigante, originado mediante grandes radiaciones, aterroriza a la isla de Manhattan, sembrando el pánico entre sus habitantes. La criatura destruye todo lo que encuentra a su paso.

programme.title: The Mask Of Zorro
programme.desc: Cuando un déspota sediento de poder planea comprarle California a México, hacen falta dos Zorros - el legendario Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) y su sucesor elegido Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas), un gallardo bandido convertido en héroe - para frustrar los planes sin escrúpulos del tirano. ¿Pero bastará la combinación de sus habilidades, sus bravuconerías y proezas para lograr el objetivo final de De la Vega: vengarse del hombre que mató a su mujer, secuestró a su hija y lo tuvo prisionero durante veinte años?

programme.title: La Leyenda Del Zorro
programme.desc: ¡El justiciero de la capa original ha regresado! Antonio Banderas y la ganadora del Oscar(r) Catherine Zeta-Jones (2002, mejor actriz de reparto, Chicago) vuelven con más duelos a espada, aventuras y emoción en el explosivo espectáculo cinematográfico, ¡THE LEGEND OF ZORRO! Tras pasar los últimos diez años luchando contra la injusticia y la crueldad, Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) se enfrenta ahora a su mayor desafío: ¡su amada esposa Elena (Zeta-Jones) lo ha echado de casa! Elena ha pedido el divorcio y ha encontrado cobijo en los brazos del conde Armand (Rufus Sewell), un apuesto aristócrata francés. Pero Alejandro sabe algo que ella no sabe: Armand es el maligno cerebro de una trama terrorista para destruir Estados Unidos. Así, con su matrimonio y el futuro del país en juego, el Zorro debe salvar dos uniones antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Resident Evil: El Capítulo Final
programme.desc: Alice regresa a The Hive en Raccoon City, donde Umbrella Corp está reuniendo fuerzas antes del ataque final a los últimos.

programme.title: Life: Vida
programme.desc: LIFE: VIDA es un aterrador thriller de ciencia ficción sobre un grupo de científicos a bordo de la Estación Espacial Internacional, cuya misión de reconocimiento acaba sumida en el pánico cuando descubren una forma de vida extraterrestre que evoluciona rápidamente y que ha causado la extinción en Marte. Ahora, amenaza a la tripulación y a toda la vida sobre la Tierra.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Andrew Neyman (Miles Teller) es un joven baterista de jazz, que solo tiene en mente estar a la altura para cumplir con las exigencias del elitista conservatorio de éxito al que asiste. Marcado por las vivencias de su fracasado padre, un escritor en ciernes, Andrew busca día y noche convertirse en uno de los grandes. Terence Fletcher (J.K. Simmons), instructor conocido por su talento para la enseñanza como por sus terribles métodos, lidera un grupo de jazz en la escuela superior. Fletcher descubre a Andrew y lo transfiere a su banda, hecho que marcará para siempre sus vidas.

programme.title: La Ventana Secreta
programme.desc: Thriller basado en una novela de Stephen King. Depp es un escritor que atraviesa un mal momento: a la sequía creativa se une el proceso de separación de su esposa (Maria Bello). En tales circunstancias, aparece en su vida un extraño personaje (John Turturro) que lo acusa de haber plagiado uno de sus relatos.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Tintin
programme.desc: Un joven reportero llamado Tintín y su perro, un terrier llamado Milú, viajan por todo el mundo viviendo numerosas aventuras.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsesion
programme.desc: Sam Paretta, de nueve años murió en un accidente aéreo. Aunque han pasado 14 meses desde el accidente, su madre Telly (Julianne Moore, "Far From Heaven"), todavía llora su muerte. Pero de repente, su marido (Anthony Edwards, "ER") jura que nunca tuvieron un hijo y su psiquiatra (Gary Sinise, "C.S.I.: NY") insiste en que sufre delirios. Pero lo peor de todo es no hay ninguna evidencia para probar que Sam haya existido alguna vez. Obsesionada por los recuerdos de su hijo, la búsqueda por la verdad embarca a Telly en una oscura y devastadora conspiración de terror sobrenatural.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. Un sargento de la Marina (Aaron Eckhart) y sus hombres tendrán que enfrentarse en una inesperada batalla a un enemigo absolutamente desconocido.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: Un aterrizaje de emergencia deja tirados a Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) y a su legendario padre Cypher (Will Smith) en la Tierra, 1000 años después de que el cataclismo obligara a la humanidad a escapar de ahí.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Tintin

programme.title: Chef's Diaries: Escocia
programme.desc: Los Hermanos Roca se embarcan en un viaje a Escocia que les permitirá re-descubrir una gastronomía oculta.

programme.title: Donde está el Truco
programme.desc: Arturo Maravilla, un joven empresario en crisis, hereda una compañía de teatro circo al borde de la ruina y solo cuenta con el torpe comediante Juanito Sin Blanca. La inesperada muerte de un tío lejano parece ser su salvación, pero en lugar de una herencia, debe hacerse cargo de sus hijos adoptivos, Joel y Rebeca. Todo cambia cuando descubre que Joel, aunque no habla, tiene superpoderes. ¿Podrá Arturo salvar su teatro... y a su nueva familia?

programme.title: 97 Minutos
programme.desc: Un avión secuestrado se quedará sin combustible en 97 minutos. Mientras las autoridades debaten derribarlo para evitar una catástrofe, la única esperanza de los pasajeros parece ser Alex, un supuesto agente encubierto de Interpol infiltrado entre los secuestradores.

programme.title: Revuelo en las Aulas
programme.desc: Un grupo diverso de estudiantes de secundaria se une para defender pacíficamente sus derechos personales y su dignidad frente a un director opresivo y aficionado a la censura.

programme.title: Escribir lo Imposible
programme.desc: Este documental sigue al escritor español Juan Tallón mientras habla sobre la creación de su libro 'Rewind', que explora la fragilidad de la vida y las pérdidas inesperadas. La película examina cómo los temas del libro sobre lo impredecible de la existencia se volvieron inquietantemente proféticos cuando llegó la pandemia poco después de su publicación.

programme.title: El Vendedor de Sueños
programme.desc: Un mendigo misterioso salva al psiquiatra Julio César de un intento de suicidio y, presentándose como "El vendedor de sueños", comienza a cautivar a todos con sus profundas reflexiones sobre la vida. Su mensaje se vuelve viral y lo convierte en un influencer insólito, atrayendo a multitudes que buscan sentido en sus palabras sobre la muerte, el perdón, la riqueza y la familia. Pero ¿quién es realmente este hombre enigmático y qué lo trajo hasta aquí?

programme.title: 1942: La gran ofensiva
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película recrea la brutal Batalla de Rzhev durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. En 1942, el ejército soviético lanza una gran ofensiva para frenar el avance nazi hacia Moscú y romper el asedio alemán. A pesar de las enormes pérdidas humanas, la valentía de los soldados rusos logra forzar la retirada de las tropas alemanas tras más de un año de combates.

programme.title: Desde las gradas, Pelé
programme.desc: Pelé era un prodigio que jugaba con la "ginga", una visión única y un control de balón inimaginable.

programme.title: El gran terremoto
programme.desc: Película de catástrofes basada en el gran terremoto ocurrido en Armenia en 1988. Konstantin regresa a su ciudad natal tras el desastre que arrasa todo. En medio del caos, se une al joven Robert para buscar a su familia y ayudar a rescatar a los supervivientes atrapados, sin descanso entre la destrucción.

programme.title: J.T. Leroy: Engañando a Hollywood
programme.desc: JT LeRoy (Kristen Stewart) cuenta la historia real de una joven que durante seis años se hizo pasar por el célebre escritor JT LeRoy, un supuesto hombre trans cuya fama cautivó a Hollywood, la moda y la élite literaria. En 2005 se descubrió que el autor no existía y que era una creación de la novelista Laura Albert.

programme.title: La directora de orquesta
programme.desc: La historia de Antonia Brico, la primera mujer en dirigir una orquesta sinfónica importante en los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Locos Por Madonna
programme.desc: La biografía de la Reina del Pop y estrella de Hollywood, Madonna. El especial explora la carrera profesional de la diva, así como su vida privada, llena de historias y anécdotas, junto a grandes personalidades del espectáculo.

programme.title: Vidas Criminales
programme.desc: Dos delincuentes secuestran a la esposa de un empresario corrupto, pero su plan se complica cuando descubren que él no quiere pagar el rescate.

programme.title: Return
programme.desc: El calentamiento global y la contaminación, así como el aumento de enfermedades y de epidemias están estrechamente ligados al crecimiento económico. Los tratados económicos que buscan regularizar el comercio a costa de los derechos y las libertades de millones de trabajadores, así como las guerras que estamos viviendo, por el control de los recursos naturales, atisban lo que muchos catalogan como “el colapso”. Mientras tanto, los medios de comunicación dirigen la opinión pública a otros temas que resultan mucho más superfluos, lo que nos hace sospechar a quien obedecen. Son demasiados silencios sobre estos temas que deberían ser centrales en la totalidad de debates de nuestra sociedad. RETURN plantea todas estas cuestiones a través de diferentes expertos de perfiles muy distintos para tratar de arrojar un poco luz sobre la complejidad del presente que vivimos.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Un rockero envejecido debe rescatar a su esposa secuestrada mientras navega por las peligrosas aguas de la política y el crimen en Chile.

programme.title: Revuelo en las Aulas
programme.desc: Un grupo diverso de estudiantes de secundaria se une para defender pacíficamente sus derechos personales y su dignidad frente a un director opresivo y aficionado a la censura.

programme.title: Donde está el Truco
programme.desc: Arturo Maravilla, un joven empresario en crisis, hereda una compañía de teatro circo al borde de la ruina y solo cuenta con el torpe comediante Juanito Sin Blanca. La inesperada muerte de un tío lejano parece ser su salvación, pero en lugar de una herencia, debe hacerse cargo de sus hijos adoptivos, Joel y Rebeca. Todo cambia cuando descubre que Joel, aunque no habla, tiene superpoderes. ¿Podrá Arturo salvar su teatro... y a su nueva familia?

programme.title: Vidas Criminales
programme.desc: Dos delincuentes secuestran a la esposa de un empresario corrupto, pero su plan se complica cuando descubren que él no quiere pagar el rescate.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Un rockero envejecido debe rescatar a su esposa secuestrada mientras navega por las peligrosas aguas de la política y el crimen en Chile.

programme.title: Una Boya Feliz
programme.desc: En septiembre de 2010, Jordi Muns comenzó una aventura sin precedentes: navegar más de 1.300 km de la costa de Brasil haciendo kitesurf en solitario y además grabándose.

programme.title: Revuelo en las Aulas
programme.desc: Un grupo diverso de estudiantes de secundaria se une para defender pacíficamente sus derechos personales y su dignidad frente a un director opresivo y aficionado a la censura.
